summary: Steep narrow street with homes 5-13 m away and a No Stopping sign.
reasons: Homes within 5-13 m along the kerb

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes line the west side 5-13 m from the kerb for the full 100 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow street under trees; driveways and house frontages leave little clear ground beside the lane.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars park at the lower end; a No Stopping Any Time sign covers the top.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign at the start
Dwellings under 10 m from the kerb
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the kerb, mostly from the east side.
